overview.problem: All activity templates are returned to all users regardless of org_id, breaking multi-tenant isolation
overview.impact: HIGH - Users from Org A can see private templates from Org B, violating security boundaries
overview.rootCause: The list_templates() and list_all_templates() functions do not filter by scope or org_id

dataFlow.response: Returns all templates without org_id filtering

components.currentBehavior: Accepts category and limit parameters, calls list_templates() without any org_id or scope filtering
components.desiredBehavior: Should extract org_id from Bearer token (via session_id_from_token), pass it to list_templates() for filtering
components.gap: Missing authentication context extraction and org_id parameter passing
components.changeRequired: Add credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(SESSION_TOKEN) parameter, extract org_id, pass to list_templates(redis, category, limit, org_id)

components.currentBehavior: Queries all templates from Redis cache or SurrealDB, applies category filter only, returns all templates
components.desiredBehavior: Should accept org_id parameter, filter templates by: scope IS NULL OR scope='global' OR (scope='org' AND org_id=user.org_id) OR (scope='project' AND project_id=user.project_id)
components.gap: Missing org_id parameter, missing scope-based filtering logic in lines 164-166
components.changeRequired: Add org_id: Optional[str] = None parameter, add filtering logic after line 165 to check template scope and org_id match

components.currentBehavior: Runs SELECT * FROM activity_template with only LIMIT, no WHERE clause for org_id or scope
components.desiredBehavior: Should accept org_id parameter and add WHERE clause: (scope IS NULL OR scope = 'global' OR (scope = 'org' AND org_id = $org_id))
components.gap: Missing org_id parameter, missing WHERE clause in SurrealDB query (line 112-116)
components.changeRequired: Add org_id: Optional[str] = None parameter, modify query to include WHERE clause with scope filtering

components.currentBehavior: Extracts session_id from base64-encoded Bearer token
components.desiredBehavior: SAME - already works correctly, used by create_template endpoint
components.gap: NONE - already implemented, just needs to be used by list_activity_templates

components.changeRequired: Add org_id: str | None = Field(default=None) to SessionData model. Note: For MVP, using session_id as org_id placeholder (as done in create_template endpoint line 228)

scopeAssignment.description: The create_template endpoint already extracts scope from request body, extracts org_id from Bearer token via session_id_from_token(), and passes both to create_template(). Templates ARE being created with scope and org_id fields.

templateStorage.description: create_template() already stores scope and org_id in template records (both Redis and SurrealDB)

createGlobalTemplate (lines 197-253): Creates template with scope='global', validates org_id is null
createProjectScopedTemplate (lines 273-317): Creates template with scope='project', validates project_id is set
testingValidation.missingTests: No existing tests validate query filtering - harness only tests GET /v2/activities/templates/{id} (single template by ID), not GET /v2/activities/templates (list all)

securityImplications.risk: Without this filtering, users can access templates they wouldn't see, potentially exposing proprietary workflows, internal tools, or sensitive project information
securityImplications.mitigationStatus: Currently UNMITIGATED - all templates visible to all users
